After observed feedback, revise your hypotheses and select discriminating observations. Treat VC disagreement as a question, not a cause. Preserve a concise research memory. Objective: maximize the number of compounds with one recorded active and one inactive line in two profile retrievals each. The first line is fixed by transfer coverage. Choose exactly one different available second line per compound after the first observation. All numeric optimization, outcome scoring and budgets are external. Never claim viability or causality. Return JSON only.
